name: heatmap
purpose: Accessible SVG heatmap: a matrix of values over two categorical axes (columns along x, rows along y) whose cell fills encode values on a sequential or diverging scale in discrete steps, with printed cell values where they fit, a legend of step ranges, two-dimensional keyboard navigation with tooltips, a generated summary, and a data table fallback.
whenToUse: Showing patterns across two categorical dimensions (weekday by hour, region by month, feature by segment).
Diverging data around a meaningful midpoint (change from baseline, correlation): use colorScale.type 'diverging'.
whenNotToUse: When exact comparison of a few values matters: use Bar Chart (fill lightness is a weak cue).
Continuous x and y values: use Scatter Chart.
Very large matrices (thousands of cells): aggregate first; every cell is a DOM element.
states: empty (no rows, no columns, or no finite values: No data)
responsive: The width follows the container (ResizeObserver) and the height is the height option; cells share the plot evenly. Row labels take at most 30% of the width and are truncated; column labels are truncated or thinned when crowded. Cell values are printed only where they fit. Reflows at 320 CSS px; wide data tables scroll in a focusable region.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the columns (first column at the right), puts the row labels and row axis title on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. Legend, tooltip, and table follow the document direction.
theme: Cells use color-chart-<slot> mixed into color-surface at 15-100% by step (color-mix), separated by a color-surface stroke; empty cells use color-surface-sunken; hover and focus outline color-text. Forced colors: outlined cells (Canvas / CanvasText, Highlight on focus).
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, legend, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: Heatmap.create with 24 x 30 cells, including the first render
budgets.budget: < 60 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Designed for up to about 1,000 cells (for example 24 x 30 or 52 x 7); every cell is a focusable SVG rect.

limitations: Discrete steps only (3-9, per side for diverging); no continuous color ramp.
One palette slot (sequential) or two (diverging); no custom color stops.
cellLabels 'always' prints values only where they fit, like 'auto'.
unsupported: Continuous (numeric or time) axes, uneven cell sizes, and calendar layouts.
Row or column clustering, sorting, and dendrograms.
antiPatterns: Turning off cellLabels, legend, and dataTable together (fill lightness would be the only cue).
A sequential scale for data with a meaningful midpoint (use diverging).
Encoding a categorical variable as cell color.
